predicate.label: flows into waterbody
predicate.definition: River or watercourse X flows into, joins, or empties into receiving waterbody Y.
includes: river confluence with an identified receiving waterbody
river meeting Y when direction is locally clear
excludes: ordinary interpersonal meeting or joint action
adjacency or a waterfront gateway alone
ambiguous: a bare meet or join with unresolved receiving direction
predicate.notes: Direction is upstream tributary or river to receiving waterbody; confluence alone must identify direction locally.
predicate.scope_notes: Includes: explicit flow-into or empty-into; river confluence with an identified receiving waterbody; river meeting Y when direction is locally clear. Excludes: ordinary interpersonal meeting or joint action; adjacency or a waterfront gateway alone; flow in the reverse direction. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: a bare meet or join with unresolved receiving direction; unclear watercourse versus place name. Direction is upstream tributary or river to receiving waterbody; confluence alone must identify direction locally.

rationale: Flow/empty/meander-to by river is the unique specific directional family; corporate asset and generic co-subject rows are not combined into it.
